instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Corporate training provider designing and delivering technical skills bootcamps in data science, cybersecurity, and cloud computing. Graduated 1,200+ professionals placed at 80+ partner companies. Online-live delivery model with project-based assessment. Seeking to implement skills verification through automated coding challenge grading. A growing organization that has moved past founder-led decision-making but is still building the formal processes and governance structures needed to scale. We have some digital tools in place but integration between systems is ad-hoc. Innovation is championed by 1-2 internal advocates.
answers.pastInitiatives: We installed IoT sensors on 40% of our production equipment to monitor utilization and predict failures. The pilot showed a 15% reduction in unplanned downtime on instrumented machines. We now have a business case approved for full fleet rollout, but procurement and integration with our legacy maintenance system are proving more complex than anticipated.
answers.strategicGoals: Our core business is stable and cash-generative, but we see limited growth potential within our current market. We are actively exploring adjacent business models — potentially a marketplace, a subscription-based service layer, or a data monetization play built on the proprietary data we already collect. We are willing to incubate 2-3 experimental business lines with seed funding to test viability.
answers.teamSize: We have a small technology team of 4-6 people including developers, a part-time DevOps engineer, and a product manager who also handles project management. The team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling integration requests from key clients. Innovation work is done in the margins — there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.

input.changes_since_last: Major competitor entered our market. Customer churn rising. Need to accelerate digital transformation.

opportunities.title: Establish Data Governance and Compliance Framework for Scalability
opportunities.rationale: Successful rollouts of IoT sensors and structured data collection (automated grading) generate proprietary, regulated data. Before pursuing diversification or market expansion, Meridian must formalize how this sensitive educational/utilization data is managed, ensuring full compliance while enabling reuse.

first_actions: Perform a gap analysis comparing current data handling practices against relevant sector regulations (e.g., student privacy laws).
Design and pilot a formal data classification taxonomy (public, proprietary, sensitive) across all functional areas.
Update standard operating procedures (SOPs) for all data input points to enforce compliance from the outset.
resources_needed: Legal counsel specializing in educational/tech data compliance
Executive sponsorship for mandatory governance adoption
execution_plan.success_metric: Completion and sign-off of a Data Governance Policy (DGP) used by 80% of staff.
milestones: Policy rollout plan finalized and approved (Month 3)

opportunities.title: Develop and Pilot an Adjacent Data Monetization Marketplace Model
opportunities.rationale: Given the limited growth potential in core services, the shift towards a marketplace or data service layer is critical for diversification. This requires moving beyond internal process improvements to building a new business unit that leverages proprietary industry data (e.g., job market skills gaps correlated with bootcamp enrollment).

first_actions: Conduct deep primary research (interviews) with 5-10 key partner companies to validate the specific pain points and willingness to pay for proprietary skill data.
Develop a minimum viable product (MVP) concept map outlining the core functionality of the marketplace/data feed.
Allocate ring-fenced seed funding (internal or external) specifically for this experimental business line.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: External industry expert/advisor in market platforms
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 3 Letters of Intent (LOIs) from partner companies interested in consuming the data product.
milestones: MVP business case approved and resources allocated (Month 2)
Pilot market feed requirements defined with key clients (Month 4)

next_steps.action: Formalize a dedicated 'Innovation Time Budget' (e.g., 20% capacity) for the core technology team to prevent innovation work from being done in margins.
Schedule a cross-functional strategy workshop involving senior management and the tech team to align on the core value proposition for the adjacent business model (opp_5).
Initiate a formal legal review of all data sources (IoT, grading systems) to identify current compliance risks related to the new governance framework.

key_weaknesses: Lack of dedicated innovation capacity and budget allocation for strategic bets.
Process formalization remains fragile, leading to operational bottlenecks during scaling efforts.
Strategy needs a defined go-to-market approach for diversification; currently perceived as an exploratory research phase.

improvements: Increased digital maturity (from 2 to 3) due to successful implementation of automated coding challenges and IoT sensors.
The organization successfully moved key processes into pilot/near-completion phases (e.g., full fleet sensor rollout).
persistent_gaps: Governance structures are still ad-hoc, risking compliance failure as data volume increases.
Strategic vision for diversification is validated but lacks a concrete execution model or dedicated ownership beyond the current small team capacity.
achieved_milestones: Successfully piloted IoT monitoring leading to an approved business case for fleet rollout.
Transitioned from founder-led decision-making toward building formalized processes (though adoption is incomplete).

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The company has successfully executed on initial process improvements and increased digital capability (Maturity 2 -> 3). However, market pressure from new competitors and rising churn necessitate a radical shift in strategic focus toward monetization and formal governance to support scaling.
